# netcup_scp_server (Resource)

Manages mutable attributes of an existing netcup SCP virtual server. Servers cannot be created or deleted through the SCP API; this resource adopts an existing server by `server_id` and applies patches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_scp_server" "example" {
  server_id = 12345

  hostname = "srv.example.com"
  nickname = "My Server"

  autostart = true
  uefi      = false

  bootorder = ["HDD", "CDROM", "NETWORK"]

  os_optimization = "LINUX"
  keyboard_layout = "de"

  cpu_topology = {
    socket_count           = 1
    cores_per_socket_count = 2
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server to manage.

### Optional

- `autostart` (Boolean) Whether the server should start automatically.
- `bootorder` (List of String) Boot order as a list of values such as HDD, CDROM, NETWORK.
- `cpu_topology` (Attributes) CPU topology configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cpu_topology))
- `hostname` (String) Server hostname.
- `keyboard_layout` (String) Keyboard layout used by the virtual console.
- `nickname` (String) User-defined nickname for the server.
- `os_optimization` (String) OS optimization (LINUX, WINDOWS, BSD, LINUX_LEGACY, UNKNOWN).
- `uefi` (Boolean) Whether UEFI is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the server is disabled.
- `name` (String) Server name as returned by the SCP API.
- `rescue_system_active` (Boolean) Whether the rescue system is active.
- `snapshot_allowed` (Boolean) Whether snapshots are allowed for this server.

<a id="nestedatt--cpu_topology"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cpu_topology`

Optional:

- `cores_per_socket_count` (Number) Number of CPU cores per socket.
- `socket_count` (Number) Number of CPU sockets.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# terraform import netcup_scp_server.example 12345
```
